notes.title: ADS v6.0.0 Release Notes:
notes.notes:
v6.0.0 Release Notes:

* V2 Standard Loadout Editor - completely new and redesigned
* V2 vector graphics load 10x's faster than v1 vector based content
* Added Tutorials for Main Menu, Loadout Editor and Shapes Library
* Main Menu displayed by default.  Added "Show at Start" checkbox
* Fixed Tape Simulator loadout's image location
* Memory footprint lower overall
* Cleaned up some of the images for Image Pack 1
* Added Image Pack 3: Gradients
* Added support for Adobe Illustrator created Json files for loading custom Polygons (requires ADS script for Illustrator - will be released at a later date).
* New Loadout Released: Luke 2 - v2 Loadout that comes with the editor in a standalone bundle.

notes.title: Release Notes v5.1.0 [12/3/2024]
notes.notes:
Tons of updates, but most notably is the update to Unity 6, which brings some performance increases.  Some new features were added as well as videos being fixed - check out all the information!

* Updated Unity version to Unity 6
* Updated UI styles and elements throughout
* Some Performance increases related to Unity 6
* [Loadouts]Fixed bug with "Custom" list showing in UI for free version
* [Home]Fixed Video streams not working for some
* [Home]Video list is dynamic and content can be added at any time
* [Settings]Primary screen selection fixed
* [Tracers] Added option to have "Always On"
* [UI] Fixed vertical scrollbar styles
* [Widgets] Added "Reset Position" button in the rare case that a widget ends up off screen and unreachable

notes.title: Aim Down Screen v5.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Video: [url=https://rumble.com/v5cf457-aim-down-screen-v5.0-updates.html]ADS v5.0 Release Notes[/url]

[/list]
[h2]Color Picker fixes[/h2]

[*] Shows only colors being used in current loadout

[/list]

notes.title: Aim Down Screen Update Stream!
notes.notes:
So, I've been hard at work between my day job and ADS - literally working through the night to get this new version out.  The sad part is, I'd said Id have it out 2 weeks ago, but the good part is - it freaking [b]ROCKS[/b].  The new UI is infinitely easier to use, working with widgets is wrangled nicely, and now we have videos for help should you need some.

So, I'm doing a stream this evening to show off the new stuff, and so this is your opportunity to give some feedback and field some questions before I commit this update!

8pm CST

[b]N30R1L37[/b]

notes.title: Significant Update Coming to ADS THIS Week!
notes.notes:
[h1]Significant Update Coming THIS Week![/h1]

Hey all, I made it back from Spain and continued working on some updates that are very significant to the Pro Editor.  I'm also going to start the store rotation and post the new reticle loadouts this week, so keep an eye out for those along with a bundle or 2.

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
* Improved boolean operations with creating vector shapes
* Exposed a slider to control how many segments a rounded corner will use.  More = smoother curve.  But what's cool is, set it to "1" and you get a straight cut instead of a curve (imagine a triangle with each tip sliced off)
* New image pack for sale:  A ton of stadia lines (the actual lines on a scope) and outer ring stadia
* [b]Beta[/b]:  Tracer fire world physics.  Now, when you turn with your mouse, the bullets keep flying in world space to give it a more realistic feel.
* Color selector refactor:  Massive improvements to the color selector.
* Copy/Paste hex color values
* Tracer Fire:  Finally adding new tracer fire to the store!

Thanks for all the help and patience, you guys have really helped make ADS a much better app and I can't thank you enough!

- N30R1L37

notes.title: [UPDATE] Key Binds addition and Application Focus fix
notes.notes:
Release Notes: ADS_Trinity_v4.2.4.202406021000
*  Key Binds Panel added.  Click "Settings" to expose the "Key Binds" button.  Select the feature and tap the keybind.

* Dragging/dropping layers and shapes in Pro-editor now is working properly.

notes.title: First Week of Release Stream Extravaganza!
notes.notes:
I really appreciate the patience and help of the community in helping me go live for the first time with a project that's been near and dear to me for years now!  So, I'm hoping I can create 2-3 reticles for release this evening just to give back to you guys for helping me out.

I'll be playing some COD and demo'ing how you can use ADS as a "Screen-Smith" to develop reticle load outs that meet your needs and weapon types.

Aim Down Screen is:
[olist]
[*] 3 reticle setup called a Load out
[*] Top level window overlay for your games
[*] Customizable (bitmap and vector graphics)
[*] Widgets! 
[/olist]
